targets.rawSql: SELECT calculated_at, event_id, canonical_pair, trigger_type, trigger_severity, integrity_score, overall_confidence, evidence_coverage, classification, move_direction, move_window FROM market_integrity FINAL WHERE calculated_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND calculated_at <= now() AND canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}' AND event_id IN (${event_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY calculated_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT event_id, calculated_at, JSONExtractString(component, 'name') AS component, if(JSONExtractRaw(component, 'score') = 'null', 'N/A', JSONExtractRaw(component, 'score')) AS score, JSONExtractRaw(component, 'confidence') AS confidence, JSONExtractString(component, 'availability') AS availability FROM market_integrity FINAL ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(components) AS component WHERE calculated_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND calculated_at <= now() AND canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}' AND event_id IN (${event_id:singlequote}) ORDER BY calculated_at DESC LIMIT 1000
